verdict.rationale: Fern's docs say it automatically generates and hosts a production-ready MCP server for every documentation site with Ask Fern enabled (fern-docs-4). It connects AI clients like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf to the published docs as an external data source for readers' agents (fern-docs-24, fern-probe-4). Missing for 10: an explicit list of the server's search and page-retrieval tools, independent or hands-on confirmation that it works, and clarity on the dependency on Ask Fern being enabled.
